questions.q: If VILLAGE is written as XKNNCIG in a certain code, how is MEDICAL written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward: MEDICAL → OGFKECN. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 110 people, 47 like cricket, 58 like football and 45 like both. How many like neither?
Q and R are brother and sister. P is Q's son and S is R's son. How is P related to S?
questions.why: The children of a brother and a sister are cousins.

questions.q: Which letter is eighth to the right of the fifteenth letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.why: The fifteenth letter is O. Eight places on is the twenty-third letter, W.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ?
questions.why: Each term is the sum of the two before it: 8 + 13 = 21.

questions.q: Starting from point X, Raju walks 6 km north, then 8 km east, then 6 km south. How far is he from X?
questions.why: The 6 km north and 6 km south cancel out, leaving him 8 km east of X.

questions.q: Which letter is exactly midway between G and S in the English alphabet?
questions.why: G is the 7th letter and S the 19th. Midway is the 13th letter, M.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks an item 25% above cost and gives a 10% discount. What is the overall gain?
Rice at ₹15/kg and ₹20/kg is mixed in the ratio 2 : 3. What is the price per kg of the mixture?
If OFFICE is written as PGGJDF in a certain code, how is TALUKA written?
questions.why: Each letter moves one place forward: T-U, A-B, L-M, U-V, K-L, A-B.
